That is a property of the approved artifacts rather than of this line, which is why the artifacts are reviewed and versioned.

reason: policy heritage-core-default permits a classification-only consultation (risky) on http://127.0.0.1:54370 — Heritage Core is a synthetic demo fixture over synthetic member data, and the screen sent is the accessibility text of a single stuck step, scrubbed of this run's own sensitive parameter values by the same scrubber that writes the evidence log.
